So we can respond: explain that seats cancelled mid-cycle are not prorated; charges after cancellation are investigated; ask them to submit a billing dispute with date, and we’ll have team review. Provide steps.

arguments.message:
Hi there,

When a seat is cancelled, the charge for that seat stops on the next billing cycle rather than being prorated, so a refund isn’t automatic. If you still received a charge after you submitted the cancellation, that’s considered a billing discrepancy and our billing team will need to investigate it.

Please reply with the exact date you submitted the cancellation (and any confirmation you received), and we’ll have the billing team review the charge and get back to you.

Thanks for your patience!
